note: The ApexLogics #105 source page divides the marginal tax rate by 100 a second time inside its own hdhpTotal (its lines 357 and 378), and the original port carried that source bug 1:1, so the HDHP totals subtracted an HSA tax shield 100 times too small while the reported hsa_tax_shield field was already correct; this corpus pins the corrected single-scale shield (HSA limits unchanged per IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-19 sec. 2.01(1): self-only $4,400, family $8,750), with the b1/b2/b3 boundary pairs re-pointed to their new boundaries, their pre-fix inputs kept under *-old-inputs-post-fix ids, and case-a/case-b/case-c/case-d pinning the verified example, the family case, the zero-rate invariant and the case-d recommendation flip.

output_payload.scope_note: Plan-cost model only: premium + in-network cost sharing to the OOP maximum, minus the HSA tax shield on contributions up to the coverage limit. No FSA/HRA interactions, no out-of-network or balance-billing, no prescription-tier carve-outs, no premium tax credits, no state-specific HSA deduction rules, and no investment growth on HSA balances. The HSA catch-up contribution for age 55+ is not applied (the source page does not apply it). Totals are the source page's own dollar arithmetic, unrounded; display rounds to cents.
